'''Nikola Jović''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Никола Јовић}}, {{IPA|sh|nǐkola jǒːʋitɕ|pron}}; born 9 June 2003) is a Serbian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Miami Heat]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He was selected 27th overall by the Heat in the [[2022 NBA draft]].

==Early career==
Jović was born in the [[Leicester Royal Infirmary|Royal Infirmary]] in [[Leicester]], [[Leicestershire]], England, as his father, Ilija, was playing professional basketball there at the time.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tek drugi Srbin u top 10 na draftu? Nikola Jović je Megin novi NBA projekat |url=https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/tek-drugi-srbin-u-top-10-na-draftu-nikola-jovic-je-megin-novi-nba-projekat-video/399594 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=27 September 2021 |archive-date=27 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210927091406/https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/tek-drugi-srbin-u-top-10-na-draftu-nikola-jovic-je-megin-novi-nba-projekat-video/399594 |url-status=live }}</ref> When he was nine, the family moved back to Serbia where he grew up playing [[water polo]] for [[VK Partizan]] as well as basketball.<ref name="espn">{{Cite web |last=Schmitz |first=Mike |date=29 April 2021 |title=Nikola Jovic: The next great Serbian prospect? |url=https://www.espn.com.au/nba/insider/story/_/id/31352746/nba-draft-why-victor-wembanyama-world-most-intriguing-long-term-prospect#Jovic |access-date=30 April 2021 |website=ESPN - Australia |archive-date=29 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210429140523/https://www.espn.com.au/nba/insider/story/_/id/31352746/nba-draft-why-victor-wembanyama-world-most-intriguing-long-term-prospect#Jovic |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Oni Dolaze Nikola Jović: Novi srpski zlatni grumen rođen u Engleskoj |url=https://www.novosti.rs/sport/kosarka/1020232/oni-dolaze-nikola-jovic-novi-srpski-zlatni-grumen-rodjen-engleskoj |website=Večernje novosti |access-date=26 July 2021 |archive-date=26 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210726073709/https://www.novosti.rs/sport/kosarka/1020232/oni-dolaze-nikola-jovic-novi-srpski-zlatni-grumen-rodjen-engleskoj |url-status=live }}</ref> Jović was playing basketball for the KK Sava [[youth system]] before he joined the [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] youth system in 2018.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović kao novi Danilović |url=https://www.danas.rs/sport/nikola-jovic-kao-novi-danilovic/ |website=Danas (newspaper) |date=30 March 2021 |access-date=30 April 2021 |archive-date=30 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210430184513/https://www.danas.rs/sport/nikola-jovic-kao-novi-danilovic/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović 0 Bek/Nisko krilo |url=https://www.bcmegabasket.net/player/nikola-jovic/ |website=bcmegabasket.net |access-date=30 April 2021 |archive-date=31 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220531144400/https://www.bcmegabasket.net/player/nikola-jovic/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> At the [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|2021–22 Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament]] in the Serbian capital [[Belgrade]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 May 2023 |title=Game Center {{!}} Adidas Next Generation Tournament |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/ngt/game-center/ |access-date=19 June 2023 |website=Euroleague Basketball |language=en-GB}}</ref> he averaged 29.3 points, 10.3 rebounds, 4.5 assists and 1.8 blocks in 28 minutes per game, while shooting 66% from the [[Field goal (basketball)|field]] and 17% from [[Three-point field goal|three]] and won the MVP award.<ref name="espn" />

==Professional career==
===Mega Basket (2021–2022)===
Jović made his senior debut for [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] in February 2021 at the [[2020–21 Radivoj Korać Cup|Radivoj Korać Cup]] tournament in [[Novi Sad]]. On 19 March, Jović made his [[ABA League]] debut in a 74–65 loss to [[KK Split|Split]], recording 10 points and 9 rebounds in 21 minutes of playing time.<ref>{{cite web |title=Split 74:65 Mega Soccerbet Beograd |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/match/153/20/1/Boxscore/q1/1/home/split-mega-soccerbet/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=30 April 2021 |archive-date=14 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220414191156/https://www.aba-liga.com/match/153/20/1/Boxscore/q1/1/home/split-mega-soccerbet/ |url-status=live }}</ref> On 10 June 2021, one day after his 18th birthday he signed his first professional contract with Mega.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović potpisao profesionalni ugovor sa Megom |url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/nikola-jovic-potpisao-profesionalni-ugovor-sa-megom/389727 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=10 June 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Prvi profesionalni ugovor – Nikola Jović |url=https://lige.kss.rs/2021/06/11/prvi-profesionalni-ugovor-nikola-jovic/ |website=lige.kss.rs |date=11 June 2021 |access-date=18 June 2021 |archive-date=31 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220531155252/https://lige.kss.rs/2021/06/11/prvi-profesionalni-ugovor-nikola-jovic/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In the [[NBA.com]] [[General manager (basketball)|GM]] Survey for the [[2021–22 NBA season]], Jović received votes for the best international player not playing in the NBA.<ref>{{cite web |title=NBA.com 2021–22 GM Survey |url=https://www.nba.com/news/2021-22-gmsurvey |publisher=National Basketball Association |access-date=7 October 2021 |archive-date=6 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211006214331/https://www.nba.com/news/2021-22-gmsurvey |url-status=live }}</ref> In April 2022, he was named the [[ABA League Top Prospect]] for the [[2021–22 ABA League First Division|2021–22 season]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2021/22 Top Prospect: Nikola Jović (Mega Mozzart) |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news/46938/2021-22-top-prospect-nikola-jovic-(mega-mozzart)/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=26 April 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović najbolji mladi igrač ABA lige |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=04&dd=26&nav_id=2145763 |website=b92.net | date=26 April 2022 |access-date=26 April 2022}}</ref> During the 2021–22 season, Jović averaged 11.7 points while shooting 42.8 percent from the field, 35.6 percent on threes and 75.4 percent from the [[free throw]], 4.4 rebounds, 3.4 assists to 2.7 turnovers and 0.4 blocks per game in 25 appearances.<ref name="miamiherald"/>

===Miami Heat (2022–present)===
In April 2022, Jović declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović izlazi na NBA draft |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/nba/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=04&dd=11&nav_id=2138077 |website=b92.net |access-date=12 April 2022 |archive-date=12 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220412052744/https://www.b92.net/sport/nba/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=04&dd=11&nav_id=2138077 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jovic, 18-year-old top prospect from Serbia, to enter 2022 NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33718313/nikola-jovic-18-year-old-top-prospect-serbia-enter-2022-nba-draft |publisher=ESPN |date=11 April 2022 |access-date=12 April 2022 |archive-date=12 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220412053151/https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33718313/nikola-jovic-18-year-old-top-prospect-serbia-enter-2022-nba-draft |url-status=live }}</ref> On 23 June 2022, Jović attended the NBA draft held at the [[Barclays Center]] in [[Brooklyn, New York]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Košarkaška Srbija Neće Spavati: Sjajna vest pred NBA draft |url=https://www.novosti.rs/sport/kosarka/1128767/nba-draft-2022-nikola-jovic-zelena-soba-green-room-espn-pik-prva-runda-najava-kosarka-srbija-najnovije-vesti |website=Večernje novosti |access-date=22 June 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović pozvan u "zelenu sobu" |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/nba/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=06&dd=22&nav_id=2174555 |website=b92.net | date=22 June 2022 |access-date=22 June 2022}}</ref> He was selected with the 27th overall pick by the [[Miami Heat]] in the draft.<ref>{{cite web |title=2022 NBA Draft results: Picks 1–58 |url=https://www.nba.com/news/2022-nba-draft-order |publisher=National Basketball Association |access-date=24 June 2022 |archive-date=14 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220614212134/https://www.nba.com/news/2022-nba-draft-order |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="miamiherald">{{cite web |last=Chiang |first=Anthony |date=24 June 2022 |title=Miami Heat keeps pick, drafts Serbian forward Nikola Jovic at No. 27 in NBA Draft |url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/nba/miami-heat/article262786643.html |access-date=24 June 2022 |website=Miami Herald}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Heat draft Serbian forward Nikola Jovic with 27th pick |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/heat-draft-serbian-forward-nikola-025927050.html |publisher=Yahoo! Sport |access-date=24 June 2022 |archive-date=28 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220628072046/https://sports.yahoo.com/heat-draft-serbian-forward-nikola-025927050.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> Jović signed a multi-year rookie scale contract with the Heat on 2 July.<ref>{{cite web |title=Heat Sign Nikola Jović |url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-sign-nikola-jovic-070222 |publisher=National Basketball Association |access-date=3 July 2022 |archive-date=3 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220703000646/https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-sign-nikola-jovic-070222 |url-status=live }}</ref> In July, he joined the Heat for the [[2022 NBA Summer League|NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Miami Heat 2022 NBA2K23 Summer League Roster |url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2022/vegas/team/1610612748/heat |publisher=National Basketball Association |access-date=9 July 2022 |archive-date=9 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220709050600/https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2022/vegas/team/1610612748/heat |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 23 October 2022, Jović was suspended for one game without pay for leaving the bench during an altercation between the Heat and the [[Toronto Raptors]] during the previous night.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Heat's Caleb Martin and Nikola Jović suspended; Raptors' Christian Koloko fined |url=https://pr.nba.com/heat-raptors-incident/ |access-date=21 November 2022 |publisher=National Basketball Association |date=24 October 2022 |archive-date=22 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221122054043/https://pr.nba.com/heat-raptors-incident/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He was assigned to the [[NBA G League]] on 30 December.<ref>{{Cite magazine |title=Miami Heat's Nikola Jovic Assigned To G League |url=https://www.si.com/nba/heat/.amp/miami-news/miami-heats-nikola-jovic-assigned-to-g-league |access-date=30 December 2022 |magazine=Sports Illustrated |date=30 December 2022 |archive-date=30 December 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221230211847/https://www.si.com/nba/heat/.amp/miami-news/miami-heats-nikola-jovic-assigned-to-g-league |url-status=live }}</ref> 

Jović was on the Heat team that played in the [[2023 NBA Finals]]; the Heat lost the series in five games to the [[Denver Nuggets]].

On 13 February 2024, Jović scored a career-high 24 points, with 7 rebounds, in a 123–97 win against the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Balanced Attack Lifts Heat |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022300773/box-score |work=NBA.com |access-date=14 February 2024 |archive-date=14 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240214154422/https://www.nba.com/game/0022300773/box-score |url-status=live }}</ref>

During the [[2024–25 NBA season]], Jović made ten starts and 46 appearances for Miami, averaging 10.7 points, 3.9 rebounds, and 2.8 assists. On 28 April 2025, during the first round of the playoffs, Jović recorded 24 points, five rebounds and two steals in a 138–83 Game 4 loss against the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]], a loss that eliminated the Heat from the playoffs.<ref>{{Cite web |date=April 28, 2025 |title=Cavs win by 55 points to sweep Heat and finish off most lopsided series in NBA playoff history |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401768037 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250429113237/https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401768037 |archive-date=29 April 2025 |access-date=28 April 2025 |website=ESPN.com|agency=Associated Press}}</ref>

On 3 October 2025, the [[Miami Heat]] announced that they had signed Jović to a four-year, $62.4 million rookie contract extension.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Heat sign Jović to contract extension|url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-sign-jovic-to-contract-extension|date=3 October 2025|website=NBA.com|access-date=3 October 2025}}</ref>

==National team career==
Jović missed the [[2019 FIBA U16 European Championship]] in [[Udine]], Italy due to a right arm injury.<ref name="espn" />

In July 2021, Jović was a member of the [[Serbia men's national under-19 basketball team|Serbia U19 national team]] at the [[2021 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]]. Over seven tournament games, he averaged 18.1 points, 8.3 rebounds, and 2.9 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jovic, PF, 2021 World Cup |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/world/u19/2021/player/Nikola-Jovic |website=fiba.basketball |access-date=13 July 2021 |archive-date=13 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210713121328/http://www.fiba.basketball/world/u19/2021/player/Nikola-Jovic |url-status=live }}</ref> He was named to the [[FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup All-Tournament Team|all-tournament team]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/world/u19/2021/news/chet-holmgren-takes-home-tissot-mvp-award-after-helping-usa-to-u19-world-cup-title|title=Chet Holmgren takes home TISSOT MVP award after helping USA to U19 World Cup title|publisher=[[FIBA]]|date=11 July 2021|access-date=11 July 2021|archive-date=19 May 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220519203736/https://www.fiba.basketball/world/u19/2021/news/chet-holmgren-takes-home-tissot-mvp-award-after-helping-usa-to-u19-world-cup-title|url-status=live}}</ref>

In February 2022, Jović made his debut for the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia national team]] at the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)#Qualifiers|2023 FIBA World Cup Qualifiers]], at the age of 18.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović – "Pešićev ljubimac" na putu za NBA |url=https://nova.rs/sport/kosarka/nikola-jovic-mega-reprezentacija-srbija-kosarka-nba-draft/ |website=nova.rs |date=12 April 2022 |access-date=28 July 2022 |archive-date=28 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220728054108/https://nova.rs/sport/kosarka/nikola-jovic-mega-reprezentacija-srbija-kosarka-nba-draft/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Initially at the preliminary [[2022 Serbia EuroBasket team|Serbia roster]] for [[EuroBasket 2022]], Jović was cut from the squad due to disapproval of the Heat.<ref name="Poku-Jov">{{cite web |title=Problemi za Srbiju: Majami i Oklahoma nisu pustili Jovića i Pokuševskog |url=https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/problemi-za-srbiju-majami-i-oklahoma-nisu-pustili-jovica-i-pokusevskog/426827 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=3 August 2022 |archive-date=3 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220803141829/https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/problemi-za-srbiju-majami-i-oklahoma-nisu-pustili-jovica-i-pokusevskog/426827 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="Poku-Jov2">{{cite web |title=Pešić otkrio: Jović i Pokuševski nisu dobili dozvolu |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=08&dd=03&nav_id=2193359 |website=b92.net |date=8 March 2022 |access-date=3 August 2022 |archive-date=3 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220803142734/https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=08&dd=03&nav_id=2193359 |url-status=live }}</ref>

In August 2023, Jović played for the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia national team]] at the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup|2023 FIBA World Cup]]. He averaged 10.1 points, 3.0 rebounds, and 2.6 assists over eight games, helping [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia]] win the silver medal. He won the bronze medal at the [[Basketball at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2024 Summer Olympics]] with Serbia.<ref name="2024olympics">{{cite news |title=Србија освојила бронзану медаљу на Олимпијским играма! |url=https://kss.rs/srbija-osvojila-bronzanu-medalju-na-olimpijskim-igrama/ |access-date=10 August 2024 |work=kss.rs |date=10 August 2024 |language=Serbian |archive-date=10 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240810110502/https://kss.rs/srbija-osvojila-bronzanu-medalju-na-olimpijskim-igrama/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
